notes.title: Bug Fix Regarding Weapon Reload
notes.content:
We want to extend our sincerest apologies for the frustration caused by the weapon reload issue. We understand how this bug disrupted your gameplay experience, and we deeply regret any annoyance it may have caused. 

[h1][b]Fixes[/b]:[/h1]

Double Reloading Issue: We’ve addressed the rare issue where players could accidentally perform double reloads, disrupting gameplay. This bug has been thoroughly fixed to ensure smoother and more reliable weapon handling.

[h1][b]New Additions:[/b][/h1]

[b]Music Player in Main Menu:[/b] Dive into the game’s atmosphere with our brand-new Music Player, now available directly in the main menu. Customize your experience by selecting your favorite background tracks, creating the perfect vibe for your battles.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! Let us know what you think of the fixes and new features. Your input helps us make Popo & Rob even better!
